description: This Java class 'ComponentResourceHandler' manages resource information for components, providing methods to load and access resource data such as XML documents, URLs, and streams within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ComponentResourceHandler
classes.description: Handles component resource details, including loading XML documents, streams, URLs, and resource metadata within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the loader name associated with this resource.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of the resource.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Reads and returns the XML Document from the resource stream.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to the resource.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the resource.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is a file resource.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full location path of the resource.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on componentName, loaderName, and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on componentName, loaderName, and location.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the resource handler.
